meta.title: Photovoltaic Planning, Installation & Maintenance
meta.description: From site analysis and subsidy advice to installation, grid connection, battery storage, self-consumption optimisation and monitoring – DoubleA Solar Solutions guides your solar project in Grenchen, Solothurn, Bern and across Switzerland.

intro.title: Every phase of your solar project. One accountable team.
intro.lead: Six service areas, one responsibility – from the first roof inspection to monitoring in operation.

standortanalyse.title: Site analysis
standortanalyse.summary: Before we design a system, we get to know your building. Roof geometry, shading and your electricity consumption determine what makes sense.
standortanalyse.benefit: You get an honest picture of what your roof can deliver – with no obligation.
deliverables: On-site roof inspection: geometry, condition, mounting
Shading analysis across the whole year
Consumption analysis based on your electricity bills
Written initial assessment with a clear recommendation

planung.title: Planning & sizing
planung.summary: We size modules, inverter and battery storage to your consumption – today and in ten years, when an EV charger or heat pump is added.
planung.benefit: A system sized to your needs, not to a catalogue.
deliverables: Sizing of modules, inverter and cabling
Battery sizing only where it pays off
Integration of EV charger and heat pump
Indicative yield forecast and system plans with the quote

foerderung.title: Subsidy advice
foerderung.summary: One-off subsidy (EIV), cantonal programmes, tax deductions: the subsidy landscape is hard to navigate. We know the procedures and handle the applications.
foerderung.benefit: You miss no subsidy you are entitled to – and waste no time on forms.
deliverables: Indicative calculation of the Pronovo one-off subsidy (EIV)
Review of cantonal and municipal programmes
Application and communication with Pronovo
Guidance on tax deductions; the tax authority has the final say
foerderung.note: Subsidy rates change regularly – we check them on the day we prepare your quote.

installation.title: Installation & grid connection
installation.summary: Mounting, electrical connection, grid operator, acceptance: we bring all trades together. You receive a tested, documented system.
installation.benefit: One point of contact for the entire delivery – you coordinate no one.
deliverables: Mounting by certified solar technicians
Electrical connection by licensed electricians
Registration and coordination with the distribution grid operator
Safety certificate (SiNa), commissioning and joint acceptance

batterie.title: Battery storage & self-consumption optimisation
batterie.summary: Battery storage noticeably increases self-consumption – but it does not pay off in every case. We simulate first and recommend only afterwards.
batterie.benefit: You invest only in capacity your consumption profile actually uses.
deliverables: Load profile analysis before any battery recommendation
Battery size matched to your consumption profile
Load management for EV charger, heat pump and water heater
Retrofitting of existing photovoltaic systems

monitoring.title: Monitoring & maintenance
monitoring.summary: A photovoltaic system runs for 25 years and more. We monitor the yield, maintain the equipment and handle warranty claims.
monitoring.benefit: Yield losses are detected before they start to matter.
deliverables: Online monitoring with alerts on yield anomalies
Maintenance and cleaning at defined service intervals
Inverter service and handling of warranty claims
Dedicated contact person with clear response times

ctaBand.title: Questions about a specific service?
ctaBand.description: We will tell you honestly whether a step makes sense in your situation.
